An optional llama.cpp engine, models re-measured, and a fix that makes every read more reliable.

- **Chunks no longer overfill the context.** They assumed 3.2 characters per token, but code measures about 2.8: a "32k" chunk left almost no room for the answer. llama.cpp then cut the answer, and Ollama silently dropped the start of the prompt. Now 2.6. This affects every read on every machine.
- **Optional llama.cpp engine, chosen per model.** `readscout engine llamacpp --quality ollama:gemma4:26b` runs the quality model on llama.cpp, from the files Ollama already downloaded (nothing to download again); the fast model stays on Ollama. On an RTX 4060 Ti 8 GB, a 181 KB folder of new files is read in 127 s instead of 181 s with `gemma4:26b`, but the same folder asked again is slower (54 s against 30 s, Ollama caches the prompt), and `gemma4:e4b` and `gemma4:12b` are 3x and 2x slower on llama.cpp. Ollama stays the default. Details and numbers: README, "Faster with llama.cpp", and docs/BENCHMARK.md.
- **llama.cpp needs a CUDA build on NVIDIA** (the Vulkan build `winget install llama.cpp` gives was slower than Ollama); CUDA 13 builds need NVIDIA driver 580 or newer. `readscout doctor` lists the devices llama-server sees and says what to change.
- **Secure by default:** readscout starts its `llama-server` with a random secret key, because llama-server allows every web origin and has no key by default (any web page open in your browser could have queried it).
- **Models re-measured** with the current scoring: `gemma4:12b` 0.94, `gemma4:26b` 0.93, `gemma4:e4b` 0.83, `gemma4:e2b` 0.70. The setup page shows the new scores and the engine of each model.
- **Optional limits for restricted agents.** `readscout folders add <dir>` limits the local models to a list of folders (reads, edits and new files) and `readscout gate off` forbids `local_edit` gate commands: readscout cannot see Claude Code's own permission rules, so an agent without Bash or with `Read` deny rules could otherwise get around them. By default nothing changes.
- **Wider secret masking** (GitLab, Stripe, npm, PyPI, Hugging Face, SendGrid and Google tokens, AWS temporary keys, JWTs, Slack webhooks, passwords in URLs, `Authorization` headers, more variable names) and two fixes: a short quote such as `None` or `return` no longer "verifies" a claim (it must be a whole line), and an empty `search` block from the model is refused on an existing file.
- Smaller: questions like "whether or not" no longer go to the slower quality model, the setup page decodes URL parameters, `doctor` and the agent installers say that `local_edit` gate commands run with your rights even if your agent may not use a shell (`readscout gate off`), receipts say plainly that quotes are verified and the model's sentences are not, and `scripts/bump_version.py` writes a version everywhere.

Update: run the installer again, or `uv tool install --force https://github.com/Anarchiejs/readscout/releases/download/v0.1.6/readscout-0.1.6-py3-none-any.whl`.
Plugin users: `/plugin marketplace update readscout`, then restart Claude Code. Restart your agent in every case: its readscout server only reads the new code and engines on start.
